stories.h: C. Woods stays at Ohio State despite the Portal Watch buzz
stories.d: Woods was on Portal Watch as underpaid for his rating, but the portal is open and he's still a Buckeye. The noise outside the building was louder than anything inside it.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: T. Mevis stays at Ohio State, depth chart or not
stories.d: Mevis was buried on the depth chart and drew portal buzz, but he hasn't moved. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff reportedly made a point of talking with him early.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Florida State keeps P. Punga after a raise, NIL goes to 160K
stories.d: Punga was bad fit for the scheme and under fire for his numbers, but his NIL went from 130K to 160K and he's staying. Florida State didn't need to look for a new back this week.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Slay stays at Georgia Tech after NIL bump to 205K
stories.d: Slay was on a losing team and looked like a portal candidate. His NIL rose from 155K to 205K, and now he's staying. Georgia Tech's boosters probably consider it money well spent.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: D.Wade could be the portal's top prize after a 3-9 year at UCLA
stories.d: [[p:557712426|D.Wade]] is an 89-overall junior quarterback who spent the season on a 3-9 UCLA team. Every contender knows who he is. Several staffs are said to be sizing up their quarterback rooms with him in mind.

quote.text: If he hits the portal, everybody's calling. He's a franchise guy.

stories.h: [[r:561123290|J. Hammer]] Chooses [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Over [[t:832438274|Alabama]] and [[t:832438288|BYU]]
stories.d: The quarterback wanted a real shot at a title, and the Irish gave him a pitch he couldn't ignore. Per a source close to the process, the Boise State upset landed right as he was deciding. Alabama and BYU were left waiting by the phone.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Top-Two Prospect [[r:561125228|J. Kirkendoll]] Picks [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]
stories.d: The No. 2 overall recruit is going to Oxford, and the reported $300K price tag didn't scare off the Rebels' NIL crowd. After missing on a couple of other headline names, Ole Miss finally has a marquee win. Kirkendoll said the promise of a starting job sealed it.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: Five-Star Tackle [[r:561121730|P. Snead]] Gives [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] a Blindside Anchor
stories.d: Snead was reportedly in the stands for the Boise State upset, and by the time he left the stadium, those close to him say, the decision was basically made. Notre Dame's history of producing linemen for the pros sealed it.

quote.text: That win over Boise State? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

stories.h: No. 4 Overall [[r:561123886|A. Leamon]] Commits to [[t:832438274|Alabama]]
stories.d: Alabama's secondary pipeline to the draft sold the top-five prospect, and the reported $265K ask was no obstacle for the program that leads the league in NIL spending. A family source said Leamon's parents loved how the staff talked about development.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Alabama develops DBs better than anybody.

stories.h: [[r:561124949|J. Gaskin]] Goes to [[t:832438337|Miami]], Leaving [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]] Behind
stories.d: Miami, graded as a top-tier title contender, won the defensive tackle with a championship pitch and a reported $290K price. Oklahoma had been confident late in the process, per a source, and this one stings in Norman.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: [[r:561119693|K. Yamini]] Picks [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Over [[t:832438337|Miami]] and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]
stories.d: The cornerback saw a thin depth chart and a team that just beat the No. 1 team in the country. With only four returning corners in South Bend, a source close to the recruit said the staff pitched immediate snaps. Miami and Oklahoma both finished as runners-up.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: [[t:832438381|TCU]] Lands Five-Star Tackle [[r:561123451|L. Coale]]
stories.d: TCU's high-powered offense and wide-open depth chart on the line made the sell easy. With just six returning tackles on the roster, Coale could be on the field early. A high school coach said the Horned Frogs were the only staff that showed him film of how they'd use him.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: [[r:561119731|B. Harris]] Never Wavered: He's Going to [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]
stories.d: Rival programs were told early that this one was over. Tennessee has one quarterback returning, the path to the field is wide open, and a reported $275K NIL number closed the deal. A source said Harris barely took other visits.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Gets Five-Star Middle Linebacker [[r:561120711|H. Wonnum]]
stories.d: The Irish showed Wonnum their history of linebackers hearing their names called on draft night, and a source said the pitch hit hard. Notre Dame's win over No. 1 Boise State didn't hurt the timing, either.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

stories.h: No. 11 Overall [[r:561124711|C. Nielsen]] Picks [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]
stories.d: The Irish told Nielsen he'd compete for a job immediately, and the momentum from beating Boise State gave that promise some weight. A source close to the family said the campus visit went extremely well.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Adds Five-Star Will [[r:561122448|C. Daniels]] to a Loaded Defense
stories.d: Daniels bought the championship pitch, and the Boise State win made it feel real. The Irish linebacker room is getting crowded with star recruits. Per a source, the staff will have a fun problem sorting out snaps.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] Lands Five-Star Will [[r:561125304|F. Lutui]]
stories.d: Lutui wanted a power-conference stage, and Alabama's grade in that category was perfect. The Tide also have a strong record of sending linebackers to the pros. A source said the staff stayed on him all month.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: [[r:561119349|T. Cornell]] Picks [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438337|Miami]]
stories.d: Cornell wanted the national spotlight, and a team that just knocked off No. 1 offered plenty. Tennessee and Miami made late pushes, according to a source close to the program, but Notre Dame's brand won out.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: No. 15 Overall [[r:561120496|E. Hurtado]] Heads to [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]
stories.d: Oklahoma gets a much-needed boost after a rough recruiting week. Hurtado wanted a title shot and a starting role, and the Sooners offered both. A source said Hurtado's family was impressed by the staff's honesty.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: [[r:561119343|B. Bartell]] Picks [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] Over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]
stories.d: The linebacker turned down two bigger names for a chance to play right away in Lubbock. Tuddy_roosevelt's Buckeyes were considered contenders late, per a source, but the Red Raiders' playing-time pitch won out.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Quarterback [[r:561123290|J. Hammer]] Makes It Official With [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]
stories.d: The paperwork is in and the Irish have their five-star quarterback. A source close to the program said Hammer was among the first to send his papers back. For a player who wanted a title shot, the timing could not have been better.

quote.text: He didn't hesitate for a second. Sent it back the same day.
quote.by: a source close to the Notre Dame program

stories.h: [[r:561125228|J. Kirkendoll]] Signs With [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], and the Rebels Can Exhale
stories.d: After a few recruiting misses, Ole Miss locked in a prize. The staff sold him on a chance to compete immediately, and he now has the paperwork to prove he's all in. Expect the fan base to treat this one like a trophy.

stories.h: [[r:561121730|P. Snead]] Signs, Giving [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] a Foundation Piece Up Front
stories.d: The Boise State upset helped, but a source said Snead was already leaning toward South Bend long before. Notre Dame's coaches reportedly celebrated this one as a statement signing for their offensive line plans.

stories.h: [[r:561123886|A. Leamon]] Signs With [[t:832438274|Alabama]] and Adds to a Strong DB Tradition
stories.d: The Tide's history of turning defensive backs into pros was the selling point, and Leamon followed through with his signature. Per a source, Alabama's staff already sees him as a contributor early. Rival recruiters have moved on.

stories.h: [[t:832438337|Miami]] Seals the Deal With Five-Star Tackle [[r:561124949|J. Gaskin]]
stories.d: Gaskin's signature gives Miami a defensive anchor and caps a strong recruiting stretch. The Hurricanes' title-contender grade was central to the pitch. A source said the staff celebrated the news loudly.

stories.h: [[r:561119693|K. Yamini]] Is Officially a Notre Dame Cornerback
stories.d: The five-star cornerback is signed, and the thin cornerback room just got a major upgrade. Expect Yamini to compete for snaps right away. A Notre Dame staffer said the coaches see him as a day-one contributor.

stories.h: [[r:561123451|L. Coale]] Signs With [[t:832438381|TCU]] to Shore Up the Line
stories.d: TCU's offense is built to put up yards, and Coale gives the Frogs a prized lineman to block for it. With few returning tackles, the staff is expected to throw him into the mix quickly. A source said he was a priority for months.

stories.h: [[r:561119731|B. Harris]] Signs With [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], and the Starting Job Is Wide Open
stories.d: With only one returning quarterback on the roster, the Vols have given Harris a clear path to the field, and he's done everything but guarantee a title run. Expect immediate quarterback-competition talk in Knoxville.

stories.h: [[r:561120711|H. Wonnum]] Signs, Handing [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Its Next Middle Linebacker
stories.d: Notre Dame's record of producing draft picks at linebacker closed this one. Wonnum's signature gives the defense a new centerpiece, and a source said the staff expects him to push for playing time quickly.

stories.h: [[r:561124711|C. Nielsen]] Signs With [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], Eyeing Early Playing Time
stories.d: The Irish promised a chance to compete for a job immediately, and Nielsen is holding them to it. Per a source, the staff sees him as a prime candidate to break into the rotation as a freshman.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Seals the Deal With Five-Star Will [[r:561122448|C. Daniels]]
stories.d: Daniels is signed, joining a rapidly growing group of stars at linebacker. A source said the staff will have to get creative with the depth chart. For Daniels, the draw was a real chance at a championship.

stories.h: [[r:561125304|F. Lutui]] Signs With [[t:832438274|Alabama]] and Heads Into a Familiar Stage
stories.d: Lutui got the power-conference platform he wanted and signed on the dotted line. Alabama's staff can now say it landed a marquee linebacker, and a source said they pushed hard for him through the final stretch.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Seals the Deal With Five-Star Will [[r:561119349|T. Cornell]]
stories.d: Cornell wanted the lights, and the Irish brand delivered. With his signature in, Notre Dame's linebacker class looks stacked, and a source close to the program said the staff has big plans for how to use him.

stories.h: E. Hurtado makes it official, signs with Oklahoma
stories.d: The Sooners got their headliner on paper. Hurtado picked Norman because the staff promised a real shot at a job right away, and he now anchors a class that needs a lift.

quote.text: They didn't promise me anything but a fair fight. That's all I wanted.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Texas Tech seals the deal with five-star WILL B. Bartell
stories.d: Bartell is signed, and the pitch was simple: come compete for a starting job now. Ohio State had been in the mix, and per a source, the Buckeyes' staff was disappointed to hear the news.

quote.text: He wanted a place where the depth chart was open. Lubbock gave him that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Crum picks Texas over Arizona State and Alabama
stories.d: Texas has one returning quarterback, and Crum read that depth chart like a menu. The 48-6 rout of San Diego State didn't hurt, and the Longhorns are already pitching him as a possible early starter.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: H. Singleton wasn't wavering: he picks Texas A&M
stories.d: Singleton, a quarterback who has been in the portal conversation, wanted a title contender and found one at 11-3 and No. 10. One source said other suitors never really got a look.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: No. 20 overall M. Lamur is headed to LSU
stories.d: LSU's passing game sold itself. The Tigers rank 2nd in receptions, and the win over No. 18 Texas Tech landed right as Lamur was deciding. A rival staffer called the fit "scary."

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: S. Soto picks Arizona State over Utah and Clemson
stories.d: Soto heard what he wanted: the job is open and he can win it. Arizona State has one returning quarterback, and the 52-20 win over Troy gave the pitch some juice. Utah's staff is said to be stung.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: No. 24 overall A. Ervin is headed to Oklahoma
stories.d: Ervin wanted a power-conference stage, and Norman is a short trip from Denton. Per a source, his family's comfort with the drive counted for as much as the brand.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: No. 25 overall J. Meredith is headed to Syracuse
stories.d: Syracuse pulled away from Minnesota late, and Meredith wanted a power-conference stage. Minnesota had felt good about its chances for most of the process, according to a source.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: K. Doss picks Texas over Florida State and SMU
stories.d: Doss wanted the spotlight, and Texas's brand plus the 48-6 romp over San Diego State delivered it. It's a second recruiting win for the Longhorns in this stretch as they try to move past the Syracuse loss.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: I. Rashed commits to Nebraska, and money did the talking
stories.d: Nebraska ranks 5th in NIL spending, and Rashed's reported ask was $295K. He also wanted national exposure, and the Huskers delivered. A source said the competition never really got a counter together.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.

stories.h: Iowa lands four-star FS Z. Alba, who said distance was a dealbreaker
stories.d: Alba listed proximity to home as a dealbreaker, then chose a school across the country. The reason: Iowa has just two returning safeties, and he sees a quick road to a starting job.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: V. Peete isn't going anywhere after Florida State boosts his NIL
stories.d: Peete spent a week on Portal Watch as a buried-on-the-depth-chart candidate. A jump in his NIL from 150K to 200K kept him in Tallahassee. A source said the raise was the deciding factor.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: [[p:557717339|M.Allgeier]] is staying at [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]
stories.d: [[p:557717339|M.Allgeier]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, stuck on a losing team. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] roster. The money helped: his NIL went from 215K to 245K.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] keeps [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] out of the portal
stories.d: [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] spent 2 weeks on TD Wire's Portal Watch, buried on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] roster.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: UCLA Talks D.Wade Out of the Portal After Two Weeks of Flight-Risk Buzz
stories.d: [[p:557712426|D.Wade]] looked like one of the likelier names to leave: a losing team, a crowded depth chart, a portal window wide open. He's still on the [[t:832438394|UCLA]] roster, and a sit-down with the staff appears to be why.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: [[p:557711446|T.Gayton]] is staying at [[t:832438336|Memphis]]
stories.d: [[p:557711446|T.Gayton]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, buried on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438336|Memphis]] roster.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s [[p:557716955|C.Woods]]
stories.d: An 88-overall receiver making 55K, while players at his position and rating command around 135K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

stories.h: D.Baity's NIL number doesn't match his 86-overall play at Tennessee
stories.d: [[p:557727104|D.Baity]] is one of the better guards around and is reportedly paid like a reserve. Players at his position and rating are getting around 100K. Tennessee's collective ranks 4th nationally, so the question is why he got skipped.

quote.text: He watches guys he outplays cash checks. That sticks with a kid.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: C.Eckert's phone should be busy once the portal opens. Is BYU one of the callers?
stories.d: [[p:557719153|C.Eckert]] is an 87-overall linebacker making nothing in NIL, while comparable players get around 90K. [[t:832438288|BYU]] is among the programs reportedly tracking him.

quote.text: Guys at that rating don't stay unpaid for long. Someone will fix it.

stories.h: A contact seeker back in the wrong system? [[p:557725221|P.Punga]] could be a portal name to watch
stories.d: Florida State ranks 128th of 138 in rushing yards per game, not where an 88-overall contact seeker back wants to be. Players with that kind of mismatch often test the market.

stories.h: E.Marquez is an 89-overall receiver who never caught a pass
stories.d: The ratings say star, but [[p:557715517|E.Marquez]] has no catches and no yards across 13 games. Coaches inside the building are said to be frustrated. Expect the staff to look for receiver help in the portal.

quote.text: You can't keep selling potential when the film shows nothing.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Florida has a quarterback decision to make on C.Keener
stories.d: [[p:557715200|C.Keener]] is an 88-overall quarterback with 17 touchdowns against 12 interceptions. That isn't what [[t:832438308|Florida]] expected, and boosters are starting to ask questions. A big call on the position is coming before next season.

quote.text: The throws that were supposed to be easy keep turning into turnovers. People notice.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Stuck at No. 2 on the Ohio State depth chart, [[p:557713227|T.Mevis]] might not wait around
stories.d: An 81-overall junior tight end with 101 snaps in 12 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.h: E.Garcia hasn't taken a snap, and his camp is getting restless
stories.d: [[p:557713895|E.Garcia]] is an 85-overall junior guard who played zero snaps in 14 games. Portal-minded programs would start him immediately. Some of his people are said to be asking why he's on the bench.

quote.text: He's a starter somewhere. He knows that and so do we.

stories.h: D.Vales is stuck behind someone on Washington's depth chart and might leave
stories.d: [[p:557711568|D.Vales]] has played 65 snaps in 14 games as an 85-overall junior safety. Programs needing a safety have noticed, and Washington may have to convince him to stay.

quote.text: He believes he's a starter. Another team will give him that chance.

stories.h: L.Heflin was billed as a star receiver. The production isn't there
stories.d: [[p:557718678|L.Heflin]] has 24 catches for 299 yards over 15 games, short of what an 86-overall receiver should deliver. Sources say the staff has told him nothing is guaranteed and he'll have to earn the job back in camp.

quote.text: The message was simple: show it in camp or someone else plays.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] deserves better than 4-8. Contenders will be calling
stories.d: An 88-overall sophomore quarterback stuck on a Georgia Tech team that's 4-8. Every contender in the country knows his name.

stories.h: Contenders are eyeing M.Toledo, an 88-overall punter at 4-8 Virginia Tech
stories.d: [[p:557713704|M.Toledo]] has been a rare bright spot on a 4-8 Virginia Tech team. Special teams coaches at contenders know his name, and he could be one of the quieter portal prizes.

quote.text: Field position wins playoff games. A punter like that is gold.

stories.h: Payday: who cashed in this offseason
stories.d: $1.38 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557717916|T.Brown]]: 40K to 250K.

stories.h: Next up: the breakout candidates for the new season
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Against the odds, [[t:832438394|UCLA]] keeps [[p:557720299|M.Reavis]]
stories.d: [[p:557720299|M.Reavis]] spent 2 weeks on TD Wire's Portal Watch, stuck on a losing team and under fire for his numbers, and our read had him as one of the likelier names to leave. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438394|UCLA]] roster.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: Ratings say 88. The stat sheet says something else for [[p:557715200|C.Keener]]
stories.d: 238-of-376, 3183 yards, 15 TD, 11 INT (141.7 rating). For an 88-overall quarterback, that won't cut it. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.

stories.h: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] vs. [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]: the fight for four-star RG [[r:561119538|K. Hillhouse]] goes down to the wire
stories.d: Tennessee leads 613 to 592, with Washington lurking at 309. His dealbreaker is championship contender. Official visits could decide this one.

stories.h: [[t:832438379|Stanford]] lands two-star CB [[r:561121734|G. Pilgrim]]
stories.d: Pilgrim stays home in California, and his parents will be able to make every home game. Stanford has just six returning cornerbacks on the roster. The path to the field is short.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: [[r:561125221|D. Aviles]] picks [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438288|BYU]]
stories.d: The timing helped: Notre Dame is coming off a win over No. 1 [[t:832438284|Boise State]]. Notre Dame ranks 6th nationally in pro potential at DB, with 11 draft picks at the position in four years, six in the first round.

quote.text: They beat Boise State and I texted the coach right after. I was ready.

stories.h: [[t:832438308|Florida]] lands four-star HB [[r:561125682|J. Van Lanen]]
stories.d: Florida ranks 2nd nationally in pro potential at RB, with three draft picks at the position in four years, one in the first round. Florida grades out an A+ in conference prestige, and Lanen wanted playing in a power conference.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Florida develops running backs better than anybody.

stories.h: Penn State keeps B. Peter out of the portal
stories.d: Peter was stuck on a losing team and was an obvious portal candidate. The staff stayed in contact, and he's still on the roster. agerm40 needed a win on the retention front.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Gado is staying at Ohio State
stories.d: Gado spent a week on Portal Watch as a buried-on-the-depth-chart candidate, but he's still on the Buckeyes' roster. Outside programs reportedly made calls and got nowhere.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Portal Watch had [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] on the list. He isn't going anywhere
stories.d: [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, stuck on a losing team. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to Penn State

stories.h: I. Stockton is staying at Penn State, for now
stories.d: Stockton was flagged as a bad scheme fit, and the question was whether he'd leave. He didn't. That settles half of the Nittany Lions' portal worry, and agerm40 will likely look to build the role around him.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Yates is staying at Penn State, answering the portal question
stories.d: Yates had been the big portal name in State College since the sack drought, and many expected him to test the market. He chose to stay. That's a quiet win for agerm40.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] keeps [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] out of the portal
stories.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, a bad fit for the scheme. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to Ohio State

stories.h: Ohio State keeps B. Lyle out of the portal
stories.d: Lyle was flagged as a scheme misfit, but he's still on the roster as the portal opens. Per a source, the staff and Lyle talked through his role, and he liked what he heard.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]] is staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]
stories.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, a bad fit for the scheme. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to Ohio State

stories.h: Against the odds, [[t:832438408|Washington]] keeps [[p:557714761|M.Cleveland]]
stories.d: [[p:557714761|M.Cleveland]] spent 2 weeks on TD Wire's Portal Watch, underpaid for his rating and about to get expensive after a rating jump, and our read had him as one of the likelier names to leave. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438408|Washington]] roster.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: [[p:557720821|K.Zinger]] is staying at [[t:832438295|Colorado]]
stories.d: [[p:557720821|K.Zinger]] spent 1 week on TD Wire's Portal Watch, buried on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438295|Colorado]] roster. The money helped: his NIL went from 130K to 165K.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the decision

stories.h: Stanford loses 18 to the portal, none of them four-stars
stories.d: Safety Denard Carraway, receiver C.J. Khaled and edge rusher Tevin Fowler headline a group of 18 leaving Stanford. None are four-stars or better, but the exodus raises real questions for Pirate_flag about the state of the locker room.

quote.text: When it's that many guys at once, the problem isn't one position group.

stories.h: Ohio State loses edge rusher Larry Jerman to the portal
stories.d: Jerman, a four-star edge rusher, is the only Buckeye in the portal, but he's the type Tuddy_roosevelt now has to replace. Rival staffs were reportedly calling before the window opened.

stories.h: Penn State loses center Noah Lefotu to the portal
stories.d: Lefotu, a three-star center, is the only Nittany Lion to enter the portal. Given the worries about Yates and Stockton, agerm40 will take one departure.

stories.h: L. Jerman hits the portal, and Portal Watch saw it coming
stories.d: TD Wire flagged Jerman for a week as a buried-on-the-depth-chart guy, and he's in the portal, leaving a hole at Ohio State. A source said he and the staff had talked about playing time.

stories.h: Stanford couldn't keep C. Khaled, who is in the transfer portal
stories.d: Khaled had been flagged as a scheme misfit, and he left. It's another departure Pirate_flag has to explain, and rival staffs are likely lining up.

stories.h: D. Carraway hits the portal, and Portal Watch saw it coming
stories.d: The Stanford safety had been flagged as a scheme misfit, and he's now in the portal. It was one of the more predictable departures of the day, and several staffs are expected to call.

quote.text: He wanted out of that defense a while ago.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: D. Hilliman hits the portal, and Portal Watch saw it coming
stories.d: Another Stanford name with the bad-fit label is gone. Hilliman leaves a hole for Pirate_flag, and the early exits keep stacking up.

stories.h: T. Bada hits the portal after weeks of Portal Watch flags
stories.d: Bada was underpaid for his rating and under fire for his numbers for three weeks, and now he's in the portal. Texas will have to fill the hole, though the recruiting haul has helped soften it.

stories.h: D. Boger hits the portal after four weeks on Portal Watch
stories.d: Boger was underpaid for his rating, and Wake Forest didn't fix it in time. He's in the portal, and at least one rival staff is expected to inquire.

quote.text: He felt undervalued. That's the whole story.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: A thumper linebacker in the wrong system? [[p:557719042|K.Malchow]] could be a portal name to watch
stories.d: Oklahoma ranks 137th of 138 in total tackles, not where a 92-overall thumper linebacker wants to be. Players with that kind of mismatch often test the market.

stories.h: [[p:557727957|V.Peete]] is too good to sit. Is a transfer coming?
stories.d: An 89-overall junior quarterback with 4 snaps in 13 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.d: 191-of-317, 2447 yards, 13 TD, 10 INT (132.3 rating). For a 90-overall quarterback, that won't cut it. He'll have to win the job back in camp.

stories.h: Stuck at No. 2 on the Tennessee depth chart, [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] might not wait around
stories.d: An 88-overall sophomore edge rusher with 156 snaps in 13 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.h: [[p:557712426|D.Wade]] is too good to sit. Is a transfer coming?
stories.d: An 89-overall junior quarterback with 4 snaps in 12 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.d: A 91-overall safety making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 230K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

stories.h: [[p:557719223|D.Chabera]] is one of the best bargains in college football. How long can [[t:832438336|Memphis]] keep it that way?
stories.d: A 91-overall quarterback making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 215K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

stories.d: A 91-overall guard making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 200K. Nebraska has deep NIL pockets (3rd nationally), which helps.

stories.d: A 90-overall quarterback making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 205K. Texas Tech has deep NIL pockets (11th nationally), which helps.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Topples No. 1 [[t:832438284|Boise State]] and Rips Up the Playoff Bracket
stories.d: The Irish outgained the top-ranked Broncos 491 to 448 and walked out with the 20-17 win. Boise's perfect résumé is gone, and the committee-style bracket talk just got a lot louder. Notre Dame suddenly looks like the team nobody wants to see in January.

quote.text: Nobody said a word on the bus. You could hear the air conditioning.
quote.by: a source close to the Boise State program

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] Went for It Again and Again, and [[t:832438284|Boise State]] Had No Answer
stories.d: The Irish kept the punter on the bench and converted 3 of 4 fourth downs in the 20-17 win. Each conversion took a little more life out of the Boise defense. This was a staff playing to win, not playing not to lose.

quote.text: We talked all week about not punting in their territory. The guys believed it.

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling [[t:832438408|Washington]]'s [[p:557714761|M.Cleveland]]
stories.d: A 90-overall running back making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 115K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

stories.h: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
stories.d: An 85-overall quarterback making 65K, while players at his position and rating command around 175K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

stories.h: Somebody is going to back up the truck for [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]]. Will it be [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]?
stories.d: An 89-overall guard making nothing in NIL, while players at his position and rating command around 90K. Tennessee has deep NIL pockets (4th nationally), which helps.

stories.h: [[p:557718961|D.Horan]] is one of the best bargains in college football. How long can [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] keep it that way?
stories.d: An 85-overall quarterback making 50K, while players at his position and rating command around 175K. Oregon State ranks 101st in NIL spending, and bidding wars aren't its game.

stories.h: Stuck at No. 2 on the Arizona State depth chart, [[p:557712542|J.Hammer]] might not wait around
stories.d: A 91-overall sophomore quarterback with 15 snaps in 13 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.h: [[p:557716580|H.Singleton]] is too good to sit. Is a transfer coming?
stories.d: An 89-overall sophomore quarterback with 5 snaps in 13 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.d: 123 carries for 448 yards (3.6 a carry). For an 88-overall running back on a ranked team, that won't cut it. Don't be surprised if the coaches shop the portal at his position.

stories.h: [[p:557715507|A.LeCounte]] was supposed to be a star. The numbers say otherwise
stories.d: 0 catches for 0 yards in 8 games. For an 88-overall receiver on a ranked team, that won't cut it. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.

stories.d: 0 catches for 0 yards in 6 games. For an 85-overall receiver on a ranked team, that won't cut it. Don't be surprised if the coaches shop the portal at his position.

stories.d: 0 catches for 0 yards in 6 games. For an 86-overall receiver, that won't cut it. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.
