stories.h: Penn State's Run Game Struggles Could Push I. Stockton Toward the Portal
stories.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 135th of 138 in rushing, and 82-overall back I. Stockton knows it. Per a source, other programs are watching, and agerm40 may need to fix the ground game to keep him.

stories.h: H. Singleton Is Too Good to Sit. A Transfer Might Be Next.
stories.d: H. Singleton is an 89-overall sophomore quarterback who has taken three snaps all season. A source says that's not sustainable, and programs with quarterback holes will test his patience quickly.

stories.h: Florida State May Be Looking Past P. Punga After Quiet Season
stories.d: P. Punga is an 88-overall back averaging 2.8 yards per carry on 132 yards from 48 totes, and that's not good enough for [[t:832438310|Florida State]]. A source says the staff is already browsing the portal at running back.

quote.text: The production just isn't there for a team with their expectations.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Penn State's thin backfield may be its best card for E. Ezeudu
stories.d: Penn State has the edge for [[r:561121990|E. Ezeudu]], whose dealbreaker is playing time, and with one returning running back on the roster the path to the field is short. Georgia isn't backing off, and Boise State is still hanging around.

quote.text: He's counting carries, not stars. Right now Penn State's math looks pretty good to him.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] vs. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]]: the fight for four-star SAM [[r:561120916|D. Pettigrew]] goes down to the wire
stories.d: Texas Tech leads 466 to 418. His dealbreaker is playing time, which could tip it toward [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]]. With [[p:557714892|A.Burfict]] (SR) out of eligibility after this season, the linebacker room at Wake Forest is wide open. Somebody's heart is getting broken on signing day.

stories.h: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] vs. [[t:832438310|Florida State]]: the fight for four-star WR [[r:561124763|K. Ezeala]] goes down to the wire
stories.d: Indiana leads 528 to 527, with Tennessee lurking at 84. His dealbreaker is conference prestige. Expect both staffs to empty the playbook this week.

stories.h: Neck and neck: USC and Texas Tech are separated by 11 points for [[r:561122986|G. Harris]]
stories.d: USC leads 304 to 293, with Indiana lurking at 259. His dealbreaker is playing time, which could tip it toward [[t:832438398|USC]]. With [[p:557719111|T.Stevens]] (SR) and [[p:557726039|G.Sanders]] (SR) out of eligibility after this season, the linebacker room at USC is wide open. One more strong week could end it.

stories.h: W. Wilds Picks Oklahoma, Says He's Chasing Rings Over Ole Miss, A&M
stories.d: [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] chose [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]]. A source close to the process says the title pitch won the room, and the Sooners' recent DB draft history gave his camp something concrete to point to.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Missouri lands five-star WR I. Favre, with Chicago a short drive away
stories.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] beat the national chase for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] by selling the power-conference stage and home-region convenience. Chicago is close enough that his family can see most games.

quote.text: I wanted the best competition, and my family can still get to games. Missouri checked both boxes.

stories.h: Clemson lands five-star WILL P. Coburn after he watched the rivalry win live
stories.d: [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]] picked [[t:832438293|Clemson]] after watching it beat [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] 50-33 from the stands. Clemson also sold its track record of putting linebackers in the NFL.

quote.text: I was in the stands for the South Carolina game. By the fourth quarter I'd made my decision.

stories.h: No. 4 overall W. Yeast picks Georgia, tells staff he won't wait
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] landed [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]] by promising a real shot at starting right away. The shootout win over [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] gave the staff a boost late in his decision.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not sitting around for years.

stories.h: E. Wolf spurns Texas for Texas A&M, eyeing J. Levrone's vacated corner spot
stories.d: [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] chose [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. With [[p:557713647|J.Levrone]] exiting, the corner job is open, and the Aggies' win over No. 8 [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] helped.

quote.text: I saw the Aggies beat Oklahoma and then looked at the depth chart. It made sense.

stories.h: Oklahoma Beats Notre Dame, Texas for Playmaking WR C. Longo
stories.d: [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] picked [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] over [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] and [[t:832438384|Texas]]. Per a source, the Sooners' national exposure and recent WR draft picks outweighed the other pitches, and Longo's camp was reportedly drawn to the prime-time schedule.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Oklahoma lands five-star QB K. Simonson as the Daulton era winds down
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] wins the tug-of-war for [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], with [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] running out of eligibility. A source says the staff sold him on starting and on weekly power-conference games.

quote.text: I want to face the best every week. That's what they promised me.

stories.h: Tennessee Lands Five-Star Athlete H. Sumner After Vanderbilt Rout
stories.d: The 51-10 rivalry rout of [[t:832438404|Vanderbilt]] gave [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] a perfect closing argument. Five-star ATH [[r:561120575|H. Sumner]] is in. A source says he watched the game and called the staff afterward to say he was ready.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Michigan lands C. Faulkner over Clemson and Alabama, fresh off Ohio State win
stories.d: [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]] picked [[t:832438339|Michigan]] over [[t:832438293|Clemson]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] on the promise of early playing time. The Wolverines' 34-20 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] hurt Tuddy_roosevelt and helped the pitch.

quote.text: I studied the depth chart and saw a real chance to play early.

stories.h: Texas Lands Five-Star Edge M. Lobato to Steady Recruiting Ship
stories.d: After a rough stretch on the trail, [[t:832438384|Texas]] has its pass rusher. Five-star [[r:561124606|M. Lobato]] liked the draft-board pitch on the defensive line. One rival staffer says the Longhorns won on development, not hype.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

stories.h: I. Ahlers Picks Nebraska Over Ole Miss, Oklahoma After Iowa Game Visit
stories.d: The Iowa rivalry win did the talking. [[r:561119868|I. Ahlers]] sat in the stands for it and chose [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]. Per a source, the linebacker's family left that Saturday convinced.

quote.text: That win over Iowa? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

stories.h: No. 12 overall J. Nunes picks Miami after its win over Syracuse
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] pulled off a major recruiting win in landing [[r:561120909|J. Nunes]]. The Hurricanes' win over No. 12 [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] gave him a chance to see them against top competition.

quote.text: Miami beat a ranked team and I wanted to be part of that.

stories.h: Ole Miss Beats Nebraska, Tennessee for Lineman M. Huntley
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] owns the top DL pro-potential ranking in the country and used it. [[r:561124635|M. Huntley]] picked the Rebels over [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]. A source says his camp liked the first-round track record.

quote.text: Ole Miss turns linemen into first-rounders. I want that.

stories.h: No. 14 overall D. Mayer picks Notre Dame, praises head coach's honesty
stories.d: [[r:561121088|D. Mayer]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] largely because of the coaching staff, and the win over No. 12 [[t:832438398|USC]] didn't hurt. A source close to the program says the head coach was in his corner all along.

quote.text: The head coach was straight with me from day one. That meant a lot.

stories.h: No. 15 overall D. Akbar commits to Clemson, citing early playing time
stories.d: [[r:561122197|D. Akbar]] picked [[t:832438293|Clemson]] after the staff pitched him on a chance to start right away. The 50-33 rivalry win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] landed at the right time.

quote.text: They said the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting around.

stories.h: Ole Miss keeps R. T. Schoonmaker close, beating Texas and BYU
stories.d: [[r:561120043|T. Schoonmaker]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438288|BYU]]. The short drive from West Monroe mattered, and the Rebels sold him on their history of getting backs to the league.

quote.text: It's close to home, and they put guys in the NFL. That was the pitch.

stories.h: Georgia wins five-star LT K. Withrow, who wants every game on TV
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] landed [[r:561125659|K. Withrow]] on the strength of its national exposure and the 48-45 win over [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]]. Withrow sees the spotlight as a platform for his future.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Miami lands five-star RG D. Spicer, who wants to be seen
stories.d: [[r:561121288|D. Spicer]] picked [[t:832438337|Miami]] because of its national exposure. The Hurricanes' win over No. 12 [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] showed him what an offensive lineman can do on a big stage.

quote.text: I want to be on TV every week. Miami does that.

stories.h: Nebraska keeps rolling, lands five-star SAM S. Colon
stories.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] landed [[r:561120104|S. Colon]] with its conference prestige pitch. The Huskers' win over [[t:832438320|Iowa]] gave it momentum, and recruiting staffers say the class is building fast.

quote.text: I want to face the best every week. Nebraska is the place for that.

stories.h: Nebraska wins C. Bolin, with the head coach's pitch a key factor
stories.d: [[r:561120713|C. Bolin]] is the latest five-star to pick [[t:832438348|Nebraska]], and he says the head coach's honesty sealed it. The 34-27 win over [[t:832438320|Iowa]] gave the Huskers a boost.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from the start. I trust him.

stories.h: Washington lands five-star DT G. McLane as seniors prepare to depart
stories.d: [[t:832438408|Washington]] wins [[r:561121426|G. McLane]] with an open defensive tackle room, as [[p:557718138|J.Babcock]] and [[p:557715830|M.Priest]] are both nearing the end of their eligibility. A source says he sees an immediate role.

quote.text: I want to play against the best every week, and I'll get the chance at Washington.

stories.h: Nebraska Adds Five-Star TE C. Humphries, Another Win From the Iowa Game
stories.d: Another rival-week payoff for [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]. Five-star TE [[r:561122850|C. Humphries]] is on board. Per a source close to the program, the staff leaned on national exposure, and the Iowa result closed it.

quote.text: Watching that Iowa game sealed it for me.

stories.h: No. 23 overall Q. Garnes picks Texas, giving it another DB talent
stories.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] lands [[r:561122631|Q. Garnes]] and adds to a recruiting haul that helps after the Syracuse upset. Texas sold him on power-conference play and its track record of DB draft picks.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week, and Texas gives me that.

stories.h: It was never close: J. Kindred stays home with Tennessee
stories.d: [[r:561120670|J. Kindred]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], and a source says it was never close. The 51-10 rout of [[t:832438404|Vanderbilt]] sealed it, and his parents can attend every home game.

quote.text: Watching that Vanderbilt game sealed it for me. And my parents can come to every home game.

stories.h: Ole Miss Beats Georgia, Alabama for M. Mullins on Power-Conference Pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] had a good day. [[r:561121751|M. Mullins]] picked the Rebels over [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. A source says Mullins wanted a schedule full of heavyweights and felt the Rebels gave him that without the depth-chart crowding.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: No. 26 overall R. Liggins stays in Utah, picks BYU after Colorado win
stories.d: [[r:561120574|R. Liggins]] never seriously considered leaving the state and picked [[t:832438288|BYU]] after its win over No. 11 [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. A source close to the program says the staff has built a real foundation with local recruits.

quote.text: I'm representing Smithfield. Staying close was always the plan.

stories.h: Neck and neck: Tennessee and Oklahoma are separated by 20 points for [[r:561122980|A. Mohamed]]
stories.d: Tennessee leads 260 to 240, with Boise State lurking at 236. His dealbreaker is playing style. Expect both staffs to empty the playbook this week.

stories.h: Notre Dame Wins Johnson, Beating Nebraska and Michigan for the Linebacker
stories.d: [[r:561120064|K. Johnson]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] and [[t:832438339|Michigan]], and the NFL track record at linebacker sealed it. The win over [[t:832438398|USC]] gave the Irish a boost at the right moment.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Notre Dame develops linebackers better than anybody.

stories.h: Clemson Lands Devey, Five-Star Receiver Who Saw a Path to Playing Time
stories.d: [[r:561121266|G. Devey]] is headed to [[t:832438293|Clemson]]. The staff pitched him on a real shot at early snaps, and the 50-33 rivalry win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] came at a good time.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: TCU Gets No. 30 Overall Ramsay as Its Receiver Room Turns Over
stories.d: [[r:561122068|D. Ramsay]] picked [[t:832438381|TCU]], where seniors [[p:557727364|A.Hajrullahu]] and [[p:557725891|C.Reid]] are about to leave. The 49-21 win over [[t:832438324|Kansas]] helped, and one source says the playing-time pitch did the rest.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Neck and neck: Oklahoma and Oregon are separated by 79 points for [[r:561122364|J. Franco]]
stories.d: Oklahoma leads 665 to 586, with Texas lurking at 571. His dealbreaker is conference prestige. Somebody's heart is getting broken on signing day.

stories.h: Oregon Beats the Brand Game: No. 31 Tobin Picks the Ducks
stories.d: [[r:561121524|L. Tobin]] wanted a national stage and chose [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. With [[p:557718826|B.Bradbury]] and [[p:557717690|J.Reeshad]] about to graduate, the interior line has an obvious opening.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Missouri Sells Playing Time, Lands Five-Star Linebacker L. Balogh
stories.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] pitched a chance to play early and it worked. Five-star WILL [[r:561121824|L. Balogh]] is in. A source says he studied the depth chart closely before deciding.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Oklahoma Makes It Official With Five-Star CB W. Wilds
stories.d: The paperwork is done. [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] has locked in five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]]. A source says the staff exhaled once it was official, given how many programs kept calling him until the end.

stories.h: Favre Signs With Missouri, Chasing Power-Conference Football
stories.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] made it official with [[t:832438344|Missouri]]. He wanted to play in a power conference, and the Tigers sold that hard.

stories.h: Clemson Seals Five-Star Coburn After Rivalry Win Momentum
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] locked in five-star WILL [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]]. The 50-33 win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] helped the staff in the final stretch, a source says.

quote.text: That win made the last conversation easy. Everyone in the room felt it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Hewitt's Jump Means Tennessee Will Need to Pay Its Safety
stories.d: [[p:557727076|T.Hewitt]] is up 8 points since last week, and he's making just 75K in NIL. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has deep pockets, but rival collectives have noticed his rise.

quote.text: A safety like that doesn't stay at that number long.

stories.h: Freshman Safety Egboh Is Surging, and Auburn Should Brace for Calls
stories.d: [[p:557728394|L.Egboh]] is up 8 points since last week and still earns just 20K in NIL. Other collectives have noticed, and [[t:832438281|Auburn]] should expect the phone to ring.

stories.h: Taliaferro's Climb Puts Florida State on the Clock With NIL
stories.d: [[p:557725065|A.Taliaferro]] is up 6 points since last week, and the freshman is already one of the better young tackles around. [[t:832438310|Florida State]] pays him 100K, and other collectives are watching.

quote.text: You don't find tackles like that every year. People will try.

stories.h: Slaughter's Rise Gives Notre Dame a Pleasant NIL Problem
stories.d: [[p:557724450|D.Slaughter]] is up 6 points since last week and still earns 60K. [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has deep pockets, but a freshman safety this good invites poachers.

stories.h: Cleveland Is Playing His Way Into a Big Payday. Will Washington Match?
stories.d: [[p:557714761|M.Cleveland]] is up 4 points since last week, and the junior back earns nothing in NIL. Running backs at his level draw a median of 115K, so [[t:832438408|Washington]] may have a decision to make.

quote.text: He's earning like a walk-on and playing like a star. That gap won't last.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Khaled's Skill Set Doesn't Match Stanford's Struggling Passing Game
stories.d: [[p:557712703|C.Khaled]] is an 82-overall gadget receiver on a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] team ranked 112th of 138 in receptions. He could look elsewhere this offseason.

quote.text: He wants the ball in space. That isn't happening there.

stories.h: Rival Collectives Eye Wake Forest QB Boger, Who Makes Far Less Than Peers
stories.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 65K, while comparable players earn around 175K. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] could soon face offers it can't match.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The question is who moves first.

stories.h: Horan Is Due a Big Payday. Oregon State Probably Can't Match It
stories.d: [[p:557718961|D.Horan]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 50K, while players like him command around 175K. [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] ranks 101st in NIL spending, so a bidding war isn't in its favor.

quote.text: They'll lose that fight, and every collective knows it.

stories.h: Penn State Tackle Peter Would Be the Portal's Top Prize
stories.d: [[p:557712076|B.Peter]] is an 88-overall junior tackle on a Penn State team that finished 4-8. If he enters the portal, rivals will line up, and agerm40 knows it.

stories.h: Zinger Is Too Good to Sit, and a Transfer May Be Coming
stories.d: [[p:557720821|K.Zinger]] is an 89-overall junior running back with 142 snaps in 13 games. Teams that need a lead back would give him the job tomorrow.

quote.text: He knows he's a starter somewhere. He just isn't being used like one.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Etheridge Is a Bargain for Minnesota, but the Clock Is Ticking
stories.d: [[p:557712277|O.Etheridge]] is an 87-overall cornerback making 15K, while comparable players command around 90K. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] has to close that gap before the portal does.

quote.text: Corners that good don't stay cheap. Someone will make a call.

stories.h: Georgia Tech's Westerman Deserves Better Than 4-8. Contenders Are Watching
stories.d: [[p:557727075|J.Westerman]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a Georgia Tech team that finished 4-8. Every contender knows his name, and the calls could start as soon as the portal opens.

quote.text: Everyone's seen the tape. It's a matter of who gets the first conversation.

stories.h: Jerman Is Too Good to Sit, and the Portal Might Be Calling
stories.d: [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] is an 88-overall junior edge rusher who logged just 169 snaps in 12 games. Teams in the market would start him tomorrow, and one source says he's weighing his options.

quote.text: You can't leave that kind of talent on the bench and expect him to be patient.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: R.Gado Is Stuck at No. 2 in Columbus, and Patience Is Thinning
stories.d: The junior tackle is rated 85 overall and played 148 snaps in 12 games. Per a source, [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] has begun asking what his path to a starting job looks like at Ohio State under Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's a starter everywhere except the one place he's playing. That conversation is coming.
quote.by: A source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: J. Hammer Is a 91-Overall Backup at Arizona State. How Long Does That Last?
stories.d: A sophomore quarterback with a single snap all year is a transfer-market storm waiting to happen. J. Hammer is rated 91 overall, and a source says QB-needy programs are already working out how to pitch him.

stories.h: Penn State's Wilkes Deserves Better Than 4-8, and Contenders Know It
stories.d: [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] is a 90-overall junior receiver on a Penn State team that finished 4-8. If he reaches the portal, agerm40 loses his best offensive weapon.

quote.text: Every contender would want him. It's a matter of when he's ready to talk.

stories.h: T.Bada's Quiet Stretch Has Texas Weighing Its Options
stories.d: Eight catches for 69 yards in three games is not what an 87-overall receiver is supposed to produce. After the Syracuse upset, [[t:832438384|Texas]] has little patience for anyone whose production has stalled, and the whispers around [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] are getting louder.

quote.text: He's too talented to be this quiet. Something has to change, either the usage or the address.
quote.by: A person close to the Texas program

stories.h: M.Reavis Could Be the Portal's Top Prize If UCLA Can't Win
stories.d: A 90-overall sophomore quarterback on a 3-9 team is exactly what portal scouts circle in red. If [[p:557720299|M.Reavis]] enters, he will headline the offseason, and UCLA knows it.

quote.text: Every quarterback-needy program has his tape queued up already.

stories.h: R.Cheek Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Production Hasn't Shown It
stories.d: Eight catches for 100 yards in three games is thin for an 86-overall receiver. The staff will have to decide this offseason whether [[p:557718814|R.Cheek]] is the answer or a trade chip.

quote.text: The talent is obvious on tape. The impact on Saturdays isn't there yet, and that's the concern.
quote.by: A source close to the program

stories.h: J.Landry Deserves Better Than 4-8, and Contenders Are Circling
stories.d: The Arkansas junior quarterback is rated 89 overall and attached to a team going nowhere. Every contender knows [[p:557712048|J.Landry]]'s name, and the portal may give him the exit.

quote.text: He's a difference-maker stuck on a team that can't use him. Staffs know that.

stories.h: F.McNally Is Rated 85, but 3-of-6 on Field Goals Has Coaches Nervous
stories.d: The numbers at kicker are not matching the rating, and sources say the staff is quietly considering a portal search at the position. [[p:557714100|F.McNally]] may have to win the job back.

quote.text: You can live with an off game. Missing half of them, you start looking around.
quote.by: A person familiar with the program's thinking

stories.h: Two Missed Kicks Sink Nevada, and N. Gales Is Left to Answer for Them
stories.d: [[p:557718446|N.Gales]] went 0-of-2 on field goals in [[t:832438349|Nevada]]'s five-point loss. Two makes would have flipped the result, and the Wolf Pack sideline knew it as the game ended.

quote.text: You don't lose a game on one kick, but you can sure lose it on two. He knows that. Nobody in that building is pretending otherwise.
quote.by: a source close to the Nevada program

stories.h: Oklahoma's Fourth-Down Aggression Hands Missouri the Win and Fans Boil Over
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] kept the offense on the field four times against [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and cashed in once. Three failed tries later, the boards are demanding answers, and a few boosters reportedly want them too.

quote.text: You can be bold, but you can't be bold from your own side of the field every time.
quote.by: a source close to the Oklahoma program

stories.h: Minnesota Hammers No. 23 Tennessee in Yardage and Sends the Poll Voters Scrambling
stories.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] dominated the stat sheet against [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], and the Vols are lucky the result was this close. Expect a tumble in the rankings and some uncomfortable film study in Knoxville.

quote.text: We got pushed around for most of the day. That's not a ranked team's performance.
quote.by: a Tennessee player, speaking on background

stories.h: Crisp's Six-Interception Disaster Leaves Delaware Searching for Answers Against Indiana
stories.d: W. Crisp threw for a touchdown, but the six picks were what everyone left talking about. [[t:832438298|Delaware]] now has a quarterback question, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]'s defensive backs have a strong tape to hand recruits.

quote.text: He kept trying to make the one big play. The game wasn't asking him for it.

stories.h: Texas A&M Survives Florida State in Overtime Thriller
stories.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] won it 26-23 after taking the extra period 6-3. [[t:832438310|Florida State]] had chances to put it away and didn't, and the sideline mood afterward was tense.

quote.text: We let a game we should have closed go into overtime. That's on all of us.

stories.h: Bradley's Three Picks Overshadow Appalachian State's Loss at Nebraska
stories.d: B. Bradley moved the ball but couldn't hold onto it, and [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] took advantage. [[t:832438275|Appalachian State]] will be looking at its quarterback decisions all week.

quote.text: He's got the arm. He just has to stop forcing it into traffic.

stories.h: Horan's Three Picks Sink Oregon State in the Civil War
stories.d: D. Horan threw two touchdowns, but three interceptions cost [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] the game against [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. Coaches are reportedly frustrated by his decisions under pressure.

quote.text: He's too talented to keep making the same mistake.
quote.by: a source close to the Oregon State program

stories.h: Minnesota Needs Overtime to Beat Tennessee Despite Controlling the Game
stories.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] won 33-30 after taking the extra period 13-10. The Gophers should have won by more, but [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] refused to go away. Some Minnesota fans are grumbling about game management.

quote.text: Winning is winning, but we left points on the field.

stories.h: Washington Makes the Apple Cup a Blowout Against Washington State
stories.d: [[t:832438408|Washington]] won 45-3 and left [[t:832438409|Washington State]] with plenty to answer for. Cougar fans want changes, and the rumor mill is already churning.

quote.text: That one stings for a long time.

stories.h: Marshall's Fourth-Down Gambles Backfire Against Massachusetts
stories.d: [[t:832438334|Marshall]] failed on three of four fourth-down tries and lost to [[t:832438396|Massachusetts]]. The head coach's aggressiveness has fans calling for a more conservative approach.

quote.text: Some of those were punt situations. Period.

stories.h: Bowling Green's Fourth-Down Tries Cost It Against USF
stories.d: [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]] converted two of four fourth downs but turned it over on downs twice and fell to [[t:832438399|USF]]. Players backed the aggressiveness in the locker room, but fans are less forgiving.

quote.text: We believe in the call. We just have to execute it.

stories.h: Colorado's Secondary Feasts on Emanuel With Four Interceptions
stories.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] turned C. Emanuel's afternoon into a nightmare, holding him to 83 yards. His offense never found a rhythm, and questions about his future are starting to surface.

quote.text: Every ball he threw felt like it was ours.

stories.h: Connors Torches Purdue as TCU Rolls to a 59-10 Win
stories.d: L. Connors threw for 404 yards and two touchdowns without an interception. TCU's 59-10 win over [[t:832438368|Purdue]] left the Boilermakers' secondary with a long week ahead.

quote.text: He was on a different level out there.

stories.h: Toombs Wrecks Everything With Four Sacks in Syracuse's 44-3 Rout
stories.d: R. Toombs was in the backfield all afternoon: six tackles, five for loss. After Syracuse's upset of Texas earlier this year, the defensive line is getting national attention, and so is its star.

quote.text: You can't block him one-on-one. We tried everything.

stories.h: Mississippi State Falls to Southern Miss as Stewart Throws for 499 Yards
stories.d: H. Stewart threw for 499 yards and three touchdowns in Southern Mississippi's 48-45 win over [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. A.Renda's six-interception game earlier in the year was bad, but this loss may sting more.

quote.text: We gave up too many chunk plays. It's not complicated.
quote.by: a source close to the Mississippi State program

stories.h: Texas State Edges Rival in 53-51 Overtime Thriller
stories.d: [[t:832438386|Texas State]] held on 53-51 after taking the extra period 12-10. Both defenses took a beating, and both sets of coaches will have plenty to clean up.

quote.text: Nobody's going to enjoy the film from that one.

stories.h: Maryland Escapes in Overtime, 26-23
stories.d: [[t:832438335|Maryland]] won a tight one after taking the extra period 9-6. It wasn't pretty, and the sidelines were tense throughout.

quote.text: We'll take it, but we know we have to be better.

stories.h: Bright's Two Picks of BYU Aren't Enough in Defeat
stories.d: M. Bright intercepted [[t:832438288|BYU]] twice and finished with two tackles in a loss. Scouts took notice, and NFL-minded evaluators are paying attention.

quote.text: He's the one guy who showed up. It's a shame.
quote.by: a scout who attended the game

stories.h: Northern Illinois Edges Middle Tennessee in Overtime
stories.d: [[t:832438355|Northern Illinois]] won 30-27 after taking the extra period 10-7. [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]] had its chances but couldn't finish, and the postgame mood was bleak.

quote.text: We had it. We just didn't close.

stories.h: Folk Hauls In 13 Catches and Two TDs Against Georgia Tech
stories.d: D. Folk put up 188 yards even though [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] tried bracketing him. Programs with bigger names are reportedly asking about his eligibility and his future.

quote.text: We doubled him, and he still won. What else can you do?

stories.h: Utah Takes the Battle of the Brothers, 33-17
stories.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] won comfortably over [[t:832438401|Utah State]] and keeps bragging rights for another year. Aggies fans wanted more fight.

quote.text: We had no answers once they got going.

stories.h: Reynolds Throws Five TDs as Wisconsin Dominates Missouri State
stories.d: T. Reynolds was nearly perfect, and Wisconsin won 49-0. [[t:832438345|Missouri State]] had no answer, and the locker room afterward was quiet.

quote.text: That was the cleanest game I've seen from a quarterback this year.

stories.h: Pena's 404 Yards Aren't Enough as Arkansas State Wins 41-40
stories.d: D. Pena threw for 404 yards and four touchdowns, but his team lost by a point to [[t:832438279|Arkansas State]]. His one interception will haunt him.

quote.text: He did everything but win. That one's going to stick with him.
quote.by: a source close to Pena's program

stories.h: Clemson's Defense Blanks Western Michigan
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] smothered [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]], which managed just 237 yards. P. Coburn, the recruit torn between Clemson and Alabama, may have taken note of what a dominant defense looks like.

quote.text: That's the kind of defense a recruit wants to play on.

stories.h: North Dakota State Shuts Out Sacramento State, 17-0
stories.d: [[t:832438353|North Dakota State]] held [[t:832438371|Sacramento State]] to 125 yards. The Bison defense looked unblockable, and the Hornets looked lost.

quote.text: We could not get anything going.

stories.h: North Carolina Posts Shutout Against Kennesaw State
stories.d: [[t:832438352|North Carolina]]'s defense held [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] to 296 yards and 13 first downs. The Owls' offense never found its footing.

quote.text: Our guys were flying around all day.

stories.h: Michigan Blanks Central Michigan Again in a Familiar Story
stories.d: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] held [[t:832438290|Central Michigan]] to 196 yards. After Troy shut the Chippewas out last week, the offense has a long list of questions.

quote.text: Two weeks in a row, that's a real problem.

stories.h: Barkow Records Four Sacks as FIU Edges Florida Atlantic, 23-21
stories.d: M. Barkow had five tackles, four for loss, in a two-point win over [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]]. His pass rush decided the game, and the Owls had no answer.

quote.text: He lived in our backfield. We couldn't slow him down.

stories.h: NC State Sunk by 11 Penalties in Loss to Virginia
stories.d: [[t:832438347|NC State]] was flagged 11 times for 71 yards and lost to [[t:832438405|Virginia]]. Discipline will be the theme of practice, and a few players reportedly didn't love the officiating or the sideline's reaction to it.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. There's no excuse.

stories.h: Kent State Goes 2-for-16 on Third Down in Loss to Rutgers
stories.d: [[t:832438327|Kent State]] couldn't sustain drives against [[t:832438370|Rutgers]]. The offensive coordinator is hearing about it from fans, and players weren't happy with the play-calling.

quote.text: We were behind the chains all day. It was frustrating.

stories.h: Oklahoma Edges Ahead for Five-Star CB Wilds, but Ole Miss Is Still Pushing
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] has a slim lead for [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] right behind and Texas Tech lurking. His dealbreaker is championship contention, so Oklahoma's fourth-down loss to Missouri won't help the pitch.

quote.text: He wants to know who's winning titles. Everything else is secondary.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Missouri holds the edge for I. Favre, but Michigan won't back down
stories.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] cares about conference prestige above all, and that has Missouri and Michigan both pitching hard. Indiana is still in the mix after its six-interception game against Delaware. Expect a busy week.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the league first and everything else second.
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

stories.h: Texas Tech and Texas A&M are in a dogfight for E. Wolf
stories.d: Texas Tech has a slight lead for the five-star corner, but [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] has closed hard, and Texas hasn't gone away. [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] wants a clear path to playing time, and each staff is selling one.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's starting, not where he's competing.

stories.h: Oklahoma clings to a lead for C. Longo, with Missouri crashing the party
stories.d: Oklahoma has the advantage for the five-star receiver, but the loss to Missouri has made the pitch harder. Notre Dame's sloppy loss to Indiana also stung. Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], and official visits could decide it.

quote.text: He watched that Missouri game. Everybody around him did.
quote.by: a person familiar with Longo's thinking

stories.h: Oklahoma barely ahead for K. Simonson as Tennessee and Texas Tech charge
stories.d: Three programs are within shouting distance of [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], and conference prestige is what he cares about most. Oklahoma has the slim lead. Rival staffs say one more strong week could swing it.

quote.text: It's a three-horse race and everybody knows it.

stories.h: Clemson leads for C. Faulkner, but Michigan is still working
stories.d: The shutout of Western Michigan gave Clemson a boost with [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]], a five-star who wants to play right away. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has not conceded, and Notre Dame is lurking behind both.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the depth chart. Whoever shows him a real role wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Miami lands No. 28 overall R. Reiff after statement win
stories.d: The 62-6 rout of [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] hit at the perfect time. [[r:561123015|R. Reiff]] wanted a power-conference stage, and Miami gave him one.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: K. Breeze keeps it close to home and picks Clemson
stories.d: The four-star athlete from Cumming liked what he saw from Clemson's 37-0 win over [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]]. Staying close to family sealed it, per people around the program. [[r:561124332|K. Breeze]] chose the Tigers.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: Tennessee gets a recruiting win with four-star athlete C. Eddy
stories.d: A rough start to the season didn't scare off [[r:561123224|C. Eddy]]. He wanted the national spotlight and a short drive from Reidsville, and Tennessee gave him both.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Rival collectives start circling Texas Tech corner E. Kight
stories.d: [[p:557718464|E.Kight]] is a 90-overall corner making 70K, while similar players get around 155K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has deep NIL pockets, so a raise could still keep him. Other collectives are already picking up the phone.

quote.text: That number doesn't match the tape. Everybody in the portal world has noticed.

stories.h: E. Udoh is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
stories.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while similar players get around 100K. Agents and collectives have noticed that gap, and it tends to close in the portal.

quote.text: If his camp starts shopping him, he'll have offers within a day.
quote.by: an agent familiar with the market

stories.h: Somebody will pay I. Rashed. Could BYU be the team?
stories.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]] is an 88-overall safety making 65K, while similar players get around 140K. A portal move would start a bidding war, and [[t:832438288|BYU]] is being mentioned as a possible destination.

quote.text: Safeties like him almost never reach the portal. If he does, it's chaos.

stories.h: M. Allgeier is wasted on a 1-2 Tennessee team
stories.d: [[p:557717339|M.Allgeier]] is a 91-overall junior quarterback on a Tennessee team that's 1-2. Contenders have noticed, and some are already planning around the possibility that he enters the portal.

quote.text: He's a top-shelf quarterback on a team that's gone sideways. Everyone knows his name.

stories.h: J. Morey has 88-overall talent and zero snaps. Is a transfer next?
stories.d: [[p:557712739|J.Morey]] is an 88-overall junior guard who hasn't played a snap in three games. A team in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and his patience could be running out.

quote.text: He's too good to stand on the sideline. He knows that and so do we.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Stuck behind Allgeier, S. Soto may not wait around at Tennessee
stories.d: [[p:557713542|S.Soto]] is an 88-overall sophomore quarterback who has taken just two snaps in three games. He's stuck at No. 2 on the depth chart, and starting jobs elsewhere could tempt him.

quote.text: He wants to play. Sitting for another year isn't in the plan.

stories.h: R. Hardy is too good to share snaps. Is a transfer coming?
stories.d: [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] is an 88-overall sophomore edge rusher who has played 44 snaps in three games. Staffs think he's a starter anywhere else, and they're watching his usage closely.

quote.text: A guy like that doesn't stay in a rotation for long.

stories.h: E. DaSilva deserves better than 1-2, and contenders know it
stories.d: [[p:557717314|E.DaSilva]] is a 90-overall junior edge rusher on a Tennessee team that's 1-2. If he enters the portal, it will be the story of the offseason, and teams are already preparing offers.

quote.text: Every contender with a pass-rush need has his number saved.

stories.h: Texas has a problem: J. Duggan is too good for a 1-2 team
stories.d: [[p:557715938|J.Duggan]] is a 91-overall junior receiver stuck on a Texas team that's 1-2 after the Syracuse upset. If he enters the portal, his phone will light up immediately.

quote.text: A bad season in Austin makes every other offer look better.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: E. Marquez rates 88 but has no catches to show for it
stories.d: [[p:557715517|E.Marquez]] has no catches and no yards in three games. That isn't good enough for an 88-overall receiver, and his coaches may start looking at the portal for a replacement.

quote.text: The ratings only buy you so much patience.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Oklahoma may be ready to move on from kicker J. McSwain
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] is ranked, and [[p:557724371|J.McSwain]] is just 1-of-5 on field goals. An 86-overall kicker can't do that for a team with title hopes, and the staff may shop the portal.

quote.text: Nobody wants to say it out loud, but the kicking game is a real concern.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: T. Bada was supposed to be a star. The numbers say otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] has 8 catches for 69 yards in three games. That's not enough for an 87-overall receiver. One more rough month and the whispers about his role will grow louder.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The production just hasn't shown up yet.

stories.h: R. Cheek's ratings say 86, but the stat sheet says otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557718814|R.Cheek]] has 8 catches for 100 yards in three games. That's light for an 86-overall receiver. The staff has a big decision to make this offseason on how to use him.

quote.text: He's a good player. He just isn't getting the looks yet.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: James Madison escapes Akron in overtime after a game that wouldn't break
stories.d: [[t:832438323|James Madison]] needed the extra period to get past [[t:832438273|Akron]], 16-13, taking overtime 6-3. Per a source close to the Dukes, the sideline was tight long before the finish.

quote.text: We didn't play pretty, but we found a way. That's a good sign in September.
quote.by: A source close to the James Madison program

stories.h: Troy's defense blanks Central Michigan and sends a message to the Sun Belt
stories.d: [[t:832438389|Troy]] pitched a shutout against [[t:832438290|Central Michigan]], which gained 356 yards and 9 first downs and still never got on the board. Moving the ball without scoring is a coaching problem, and Chippewas staffers know it.

quote.text: They gave up yards between the 20s and nothing when it counted. That's a defense that knows who it is.
quote.by: A rival staffer who studied the film

stories.h: T. Pitts ran wild on Bowling Green, bracket coverage and all
stories.d: [[p:557715702|T.Pitts]] finished with 8 catches, 216 yards and a touchdown against [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]], which tried to bracket him and got nowhere. Expect his name to come up in bigger rooms soon.

quote.text: You can double him all day. Then he just goes and takes the ball away from you.
quote.by: A scout who attended the game

stories.h: Will D. Carraway Leave Stanford's Struggling Pass Defense This Offseason?
stories.d: D. Carraway is an 85-overall hybrid safety on a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] defense ranked 126th of 138 against the pass. A source close to the program says his camp has started fielding calls. Contenders would love him.

quote.text: He's too good to be a bystander on that defense.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Yates Could Test Market as Penn State's Sack Drought Drags On
stories.d: R. Yates is an 83-overall power rusher on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 120th of 138 in sacks. A source says rival staffs are already tracking him. agerm40 has a decision to make this offseason.

quote.text: Guys like that want to hunt quarterbacks, not watch them.

stories.h: Stanford's offensive struggles could cost it lineman D. Hilliman
stories.d: [[p:557717563|D.Hilliman]], an 81-overall raw strength guard, plays for a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] offense ranked 118th of 138 in total yardage. Per a source, he's started to wonder if a better situation is out there.

quote.text: Linemen want to be part of something that moves the ball. Right now that's not Stanford.
quote.by: A source close to the program

stories.h: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] survives [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] in a one-point thriller
stories.d: The Broncos took the one-point win and left the Sun Devils with a lot to answer for. Arizona State was the better-ranked team and left with the worse result. A slide in the polls is coming, and a few Tempe boosters are already grumbling.

quote.text: We don't care who's ranked where. We showed up and made one more play than they did.

stories.h: [[t:832438379|Stanford]] goes for it four times, and the fan base explodes
stories.d: Three failed fourth-down tries against [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] have turned the Stanford message boards into a bonfire. Inside the building, a source says the players liked the aggression, but the staff is hearing it from donors.

quote.text: I trusted my guys. We came up short.

stories.h: [[t:832438411|Western Kentucky]] erases a 21-point hole to stun [[t:832438402|UTEP]] in overtime
stories.d: UTEP looked finished-in-reverse, up big after three quarters, then watched Western Kentucky win the fourth 21-0 and take it in overtime, 48-42. A source says the UTEP sideline got very quiet before the extra period.

quote.text: Nobody panicked. Somebody on the bench just said 'one play at a time,' and we believed it.

stories.h: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]]'s four picks leave [[t:832438398|USC]] with plenty of questions
stories.d: Four interceptions and no touchdowns against [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] put the USC quarterback in a spotlight he didn't want. A source says staffers were stunned by how many of the throws were forced.

quote.text: He kept trying to win the game on one throw. You can't do that against a team that is waiting for it.
quote.by: a source close to the USC program

stories.h: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] shocks No. 12 [[t:832438344|Missouri]] by two points
stories.d: Missouri's 19-17 loss in Boulder shreds a ranking and complicates its recruiting pitch. Both [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] and [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] have Missouri high on their lists, and rival staffs will make sure they hear about it.

quote.text: Every rival is going to say Missouri is not who they said they were. That's the recruiting pitch against them this week.

stories.h: [[t:832438349|Nevada]] drowns in yellow against [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]
stories.d: Eleven penalties for 95 yards kept Nevada from ever getting comfortable against the Buckeyes. Tuddy_roosevelt gets a comfortable win after the Nebraska stumble, and a source says Nevada's practice this week will be 'ugly'.

quote.text: We gave them every inch and then some. That's on us, not them.

stories.h: [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] edges [[t:832438398|USC]] in overtime, adding to its growing résumé
stories.d: Syracuse took the extra period 6-0 and left USC wondering how it let one slip away. After last week's win over Texas, the Orange are no longer a surprise, and recruits are noticing.

quote.text: People keep saying they got lucky. After two weeks, that stops being a story.

stories.h: [[t:832438321|Iowa State]] bets on fourth down, loses to [[t:832438320|Iowa]]
stories.d: Two failed fourth-down tries cost Iowa State, and the analytics crowd and the fan base are now at odds. A source says the head coach stood by the decisions in the locker room, but boosters are not as calm.

quote.text: The numbers say go. The scoreboard says punt. The fans are going to remember the scoreboard.

stories.h: [[p:557723567|L.Griggs]] torches [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] for five touchdowns
stories.d: Griggs threw for 328 yards in Washington's 48-34 win, and Tennessee's secondary spent the day chasing him. A source says the Vols staff has been sour about their coverage breakdowns all week.

quote.text: We knew what was coming and still couldn't stop it. That's what hurts.

stories.h: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] picks off [[p:557718221|T.Yoder]] four times
stories.d: Yoder's rough day, with only a single touchdown to offset four interceptions, was a showcase for Ole Miss's secondary. Five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] saw it, and a source says the Rebels' staff made sure he did.

quote.text: Every corner wants to play where the ball finds you. That's Oxford right now.
quote.by: a source close to the Ole Miss program

stories.h: [[p:557727686|B.Holloway]]'s three picks sink [[t:832438390|Tulane]] against [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]
stories.d: Holloway put up two touchdowns, but his three interceptions decided it for Mississippi State. After a six-interception week for A. Renda, the Bulldogs' defense gave the offense a much-needed bounce-back.

quote.text: It felt good to be on the other end of it for once.

stories.h: [[p:557725879|R.Waggoner]]'s three interceptions doom [[t:832438283|Baylor]] against [[t:832438288|BYU]]
stories.d: Waggoner's long afternoon ended with three picks and a loss for the Bears. A source says the offense had no answer once BYU started sitting on his throws.

quote.text: He kept trying to squeeze it in. At some point you have to take the checkdown.
quote.by: a source close to the Baylor program

stories.h: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]]'s fourth-down gambles backfire against [[t:832438372|Sam Houston]]
stories.d: Three turnovers on downs turned a close game into a loss for New Mexico State. A source says the punter spent most of the day on the sideline in disbelief.

quote.text: Coach believes in the plan. Doesn't mean the plan worked.

stories.h: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] steamrolls FCS Southeast, 52-10
stories.d: 627 yards made this a layup for agerm40's group. A source says I. Stockton's workload was light, but other programs keep an eye on him, and the film still shows a strong running game.

quote.text: We just wanted to keep the tempo up. The run game was setting everything up.

stories.h: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] blanks FCS Northwest, 34-0
stories.d: The Aggies held FCS Northwest to no yards and no first downs. A source says A&M's staff used the day to rest starters and polish their pitch to [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]].

quote.text: That's the kind of defense that gets a corner excited.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas A&M program

stories.h: [[p:557723721|B.Beaver]] shreds a defense for 460 yards in LSU's romp
stories.d: Beaver completed 31 of 38 with no interceptions in a 56-17 LSU win. A source says opposing coordinators were already studying his film before the game ended.

quote.text: He saw everything before it happened. It was a clinic.

stories.h: [[p:557717471|P.Harris]] throws five touchdowns as Louisiana rolls, 45-6
stories.d: Harris threw for 317 yards and a lopsided win. A source says Louisiana's coaches are quietly pleased with how efficient the passing game looked and a few scouts took notes.

quote.text: When the protection is that good, the throws are easy.

stories.h: [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] wins the Backyard Brawl on the last possession
stories.d: Pitt held on in a game that went to the wire, as these always do. A source says the Panthers' sideline erupted while the other side stood stunned.

quote.text: It doesn't matter how it looks. We won, and nobody can take that from us.

stories.d: TCU piled up 609 yards in a rout, and Air Force's film session will be unpleasant. A source says Air Force's staff privately expected a tougher fight.

quote.text: We just couldn't get off the field. It was one long afternoon.

stories.h: [[t:832438281|Auburn]] pitches a 51-0 shutout of [[t:832438329|Liberty]]
stories.d: Liberty managed just 180 yards and 7 first downs against Auburn. A source says the Tigers' staff used the blowout to see depth players and rebuild confidence.

quote.text: That's the kind of game that tells you the work is paying off.

stories.h: [[p:557717838|R.Levine]] racks up three sacks in Michigan's 49-21 win
stories.d: Levine finished with five tackles, three of them for loss, and turned the opposing backfield into his office. A source says NFL scouts left impressed.

quote.text: He wins before the snap. You can see the tackle wondering what to do.

stories.h: [[p:557726041|T.Sanders]] picks off [[t:832438324|Kansas]] twice in Virginia's win
stories.d: Sanders added four tackles to his two interceptions as Virginia won 34-24. A source says Kansas's staff spent the week warning receivers about his instincts.

quote.text: I just read the quarterback's eyes. They kept telling me where it was going.

stories.h: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] flagged 12 times in loss to [[t:832438311|Fresno State]]
stories.d: Twelve penalties for 86 yards made the loss an ugly one. It's a bad look as [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] weighs the Red Raiders, and a source says rivals are already bringing it up.

quote.text: Discipline is the first thing a recruit asks about. That game didn't help.

stories.h: [[t:832438375|SMU]] converts just two of 13 third downs in loss to [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]]
stories.d: Drives kept dying at the worst time for SMU. A source says the Mustangs' offense looked tentative, and the stall won't help the pitch to recruits like B. Bouye.

quote.text: Every drive felt like third-and-long. We never found a rhythm.

stories.h: [[p:557718616|G.Babers]] torches [[t:832438409|Washington State]] for three touchdowns
stories.d: Babers needed only four catches to rack up 135 yards and three scores, including a 60-yarder. A source says Washington State's corners were still arguing about the coverage on the sideline.

quote.text: Once he got a step, there was no catching him.

stories.h: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] battle for [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with Texas lurking
stories.d: Ole Miss holds the lead, but Oklahoma is hot on its heels and Texas is still in it. Wilds' dealbreaker is championship contention, and a source says the Rebels' pitch is built on that. Somebody's heart will be broken.

quote.text: He keeps asking one thing: who's winning titles. That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] clings to the lead for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], Michigan close behind
stories.d: Missouri still leads, but Michigan is lurking and Indiana is close. Favre cares most about conference prestige, and a source says Missouri's loss to Colorado gave rivals ammunition.

quote.text: Everyone is going to throw that Colorado loss at them. They need a good answer.

stories.h: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] leads [[t:832438384|Texas]] for five-star corner [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]]
stories.d: Texas Tech has the edge over Texas, with Texas A&M lurking. Wolf's dealbreaker is playing time, and a source says the Red Raiders have promised an early role, which makes the penalty-filled loss to Fresno State a worry.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's starting. Everything else is secondary.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] barely leads [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] for five-star WR [[r:561120536|C. Longo]]
stories.d: Notre Dame holds a razor-thin lead over Oklahoma, with Missouri still in range. Longo cares about brand exposure, and a source says official visits could decide the race.

quote.text: He wants the biggest stage. Whoever shows him that on a visit wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Tennessee Holds Slim Edge for K. Simonson as Oklahoma Pushes Back
stories.d: Tennessee has the lead, but [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]] keeps coming back to conference prestige, and that keeps Oklahoma and Texas Tech in the conversation. One more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps asking the same thing: where does he play on Saturdays, and who is he lining up against? That's the whole conversation.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Notre Dame Leads for C. Faulkner, but Clemson Won't Fold
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has the lead for five-star [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]], but [[t:832438293|Clemson]] is still pushing and Michigan hasn't left. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and the Irish may have to answer questions about their own depth chart.

quote.text: He wants to know who's in front of him. He's heard the pitches, and now he wants the depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: NC State's E.Udoh Is Drawing Interest From Rival Collectives
stories.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while comparable players at his position get around 105K. [[t:832438347|NC State]] should expect calls to his camp once the portal opens.

quote.text: Everybody knows what he's worth. The question is whether NC State fixes it before somebody else does.

stories.h: I.Rashed Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]] is an 88-overall safety making 65K. Players with his rating at his position command around 140K, and that gap rarely lasts once the portal opens. Rival collectives know it.

quote.text: You don't find 88-rated safeties at that price. Someone is going to make a call.

stories.h: Will Wake Forest Be the Team to Open the Checkbook for D.Boger?
stories.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 84-overall quarterback making 65K, and the market for that rating is around 155K. A quarterback that underpaid won't stay quiet for long, and [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] is one of the names being floated.

quote.text: Quarterbacks at that number don't last. If his current school doesn't adjust, he'll have options.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Sophomore Punter T.Gayton Is Too Good to Sit and Could Leave
stories.d: [[p:557711446|T.Gayton]] is an 82-overall sophomore punter with no snaps in three games. Special teams coaches elsewhere would start him tomorrow, so a transfer feels more likely than not.

quote.text: He's good enough to start almost anywhere, and he knows it. Sitting is going to wear on him.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J.Pyke Is Stuck at No. 3 at Notre Dame and May Not Wait
stories.d: [[p:557715137|J.Pyke]] is an 83-overall junior guard with no snaps in three games, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has him third on the depth chart. The portal could look appealing, and it comes while the Irish are selling playing time to recruits.

quote.text: He thought he'd be playing by now. Three games without a snap is a long time for a guy with that rating.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: H.Wonnum Is Too Good to Sit, and Transfer Chatter Is Starting
stories.d: [[p:557713073|H.Wonnum]] is an 83-overall sophomore middle linebacker with only 11 snaps in three games. Programs shopping the portal for linebackers would start him right away.

quote.text: Guys like him don't stay on the bench for long. Somebody will offer him a starting job.

stories.h: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] bolts [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] for [[t:832438379|Stanford]]
stories.d: Harrell leaves Greenville after going 19-19 and takes over a Stanford team still searching for its first win. Per a source, the pitch was a long runway and a clean slate, a contrast with a Pirates job that now sits with Pirate_flag.

quote.text: He wanted a place where nobody expects a miracle by October. He can build it his way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Syracuse stuns Texas, and rival recruiters smell blood
stories.d: The Longhorns were ranked 16th and got outgained and outmuscled at home by [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Rival staffs chasing Texas targets are already working the phones, per a source.

quote.text: You can't sell 'national contender' the week after that tape goes around.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

stories.h: A.Renda's six-interception disaster leaves Mississippi State searching for answers
stories.d: [[p:557725897|A.Renda]] kept throwing into traffic and [[t:832438381|TCU]] kept collecting. Teammates were short on words afterward, and the quarterback room may not stay quiet for long, a source said.

quote.text: He kept trying to make one big play. We needed him to take the easy one.
quote.by: a source close to the Mississippi State program

stories.h: Buffalo's fourth-down obsession burns it, and the fan base is livid
stories.d: [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] kept the offense on the field and kept coming up empty against [[t:832438370|Rutgers]]. Boosters are grumbling that the staff trusted the chalkboard over its own kicker.

quote.text: Take the points once in a while. Nobody gets fired for taking the points.

stories.h: R.Crum's three picks put Texas's quarterback spot under the microscope
stories.d: [[p:557713620|R.Crum]] gave the ball away three times in the upset loss to [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Sources say the staff will spend the week deciding how much patience is left.

quote.text: Nobody in that building is pointing fingers, but everybody saw the tape.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas program

stories.h: L.Connors turns Mississippi State's secondary into target practice
stories.d: [[p:557716196|L.Connors]] threw for six touchdowns as [[t:832438381|TCU]] rolled to a 61-14 win over [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. NFL-minded scouts in the press box were taking notes.

stories.h: Coastal Carolina storms back in the fourth against an FCS Midwest foe
stories.d: [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] trailed 27-13 entering the final quarter, then won it 17-0. The sideline got loud, and a halftime message apparently didn't land until the third quarter ended.

quote.text: We stopped waiting for something to happen and made it happen.

stories.h: West Virginia erases a fourth-quarter hole to beat NC State in a 52-49 thriller
stories.d: [[t:832438410|West Virginia]] trailed 41-28 after three quarters and won the last one 24-8. [[t:832438347|NC State]] let it slip, and its coaches may spend the week fielding questions about the closing defense.

quote.text: That's a locker room that does not quit. Period.
quote.by: a source close to the West Virginia program

stories.h: Wyoming rallies past UTEP after trailing entering the fourth
stories.d: [[t:832438414|Wyoming]] trailed 35-24 after three and outscored [[t:832438402|UTEP]] 17-3 down the stretch. The defense found itself late, and the sideline credited a halftime adjustment.

stories.h: New Mexico State shuts out an FCS East team in the fourth to steal it
stories.d: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]] trailed 21-10 after three quarters and won the fourth 21-0. A booster at the game said the energy in the stadium flipped when the defense got a stop.

quote.text: You could feel it change. Nobody wanted to be the one who blinked.

stories.h: Ole Miss refuses to punt, converts every fourth down in 52-13 rout
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] went 4-for-4 on fourth down against [[t:832438365|Oregon State]], a statement that can't hurt with elite recruits watching. Word is the staff sold that aggression on visits this week.

quote.text: That's the program we're building. We play to win.
quote.by: a source close to the Ole Miss program

stories.h: Virginia Tech's fourth-down math doesn't survive contact with Arizona
stories.d: [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438276|Arizona]]. The numbers crowd will argue it was right, but the fan base has stopped listening.

quote.text: It's fine until it fails, and it failed three times.

stories.h: Stockton scores four times and gives Penn State's run game a lift
stories.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] ran through contact all afternoon, breaking seven tackles on the way to four touchdowns. That helps agerm40 answer the rushing questions, and it will make Stockton's name pop up on rival staffs' radar.

quote.text: He runs angry. Once he starts, you can't tackle him with one guy.

stories.h: J.Landry throws for 411 yards and still loses to Texas Tech
stories.d: [[p:557712048|J.Landry]] did everything he could, but [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] escaped 35-33. Texas Tech's staff will take the win, and Landry's team will wonder how a monster day ended in a loss.

quote.text: We left too many points out there. That's on all of us.

stories.h: K.Hayward's three interceptions power Iowa's 49-19 win over Florida Atlantic
stories.d: [[p:557724765|K.Hayward]] grabbed three passes against [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]], making him the player opposing offensive coordinators will be talking about this week.

stories.h: Sacramento State survives an overtime scare, 21-14
stories.d: [[t:832438371|Sacramento State]] needed the extra period to beat an FCS West opponent, taking overtime 7-0. A source said the postgame locker room was more relief than celebration.

stories.h: Auburn's ten penalties hand Miami the game
stories.d: [[t:832438281|Auburn]] kept shooting itself in the foot against [[t:832438337|Miami]], and the coaches weren't happy. Expect a punishing week of practice for the Tigers.

quote.text: Practice is going to be a lot less fun this week.

stories.h: Notre Dame's ten penalties leave a bad look against Indiana
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] lost its composure and the loss to [[t:832438319|Indiana]] followed. A prime-time stage was supposed to help the Irish pitch recruits, and instead rival staffs are already using the tape.

quote.text: That's the kind of film other programs love to show a recruit.

stories.h: D.Melton can't be stopped, torches Central Michigan for four scores
stories.d: [[p:557727821|D.Melton]] saw bracket coverage and made it irrelevant. Bigger programs are expected to check on his situation, per a source.

quote.text: He's a different tier. You can't scheme him out of a game.

stories.h: J.Daly throws three picks, but San Jose State escapes UTSA
stories.d: [[p:557717973|J.Daly]] threw for two touchdowns and three interceptions in a shaky win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]]. His coach was reportedly not thrilled with the decision-making in the second half.

quote.text: We won, but he knows he has to be cleaner.
quote.by: a source close to the San Jose State program

stories.h: Minnesota blanks an FCS East opponent, 17-0, and the offense never got a first down
stories.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] didn't just win, it made the opposition's afternoon a disaster. The defense dominated from the first series, per a source.

stories.h: D.Tuman wrecks UAB's opponent with three sacks in a 38-14 win
stories.d: [[p:557724775|D.Tuman]] lived in the backfield all game. Scouts were already comparing his burst to an NFL edge rusher, a source said.

quote.text: Every time I looked up, 94 was already there.

stories.h: K.Huntley picks off Washington State twice in a loss
stories.d: [[p:557717959|K.Huntley]] played a monster game that his team couldn't turn into a win against [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. His teammates were frustrated that the defense did everything but win.

quote.text: I did my job. That doesn't help if we lose.

stories.h: Northwestern can't move the chains and loses to Texas A&M
stories.d: [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] went 2-for-13 on third down, and the play-calling is going to take heat. A source said some players were unhappy with the plan.

quote.text: We kept running into the same wall. Nothing changed.

stories.h: Baylor flattens an FCS West opponent, 51-7
stories.d: [[t:832438283|Baylor]] piled up 532 yards and let the starters watch the end. The Bears' coach was reportedly happy with the effort.

stories.h: UCF buries Kennesaw State, 45-7
stories.d: [[t:832438393|UCF]] gained 553 yards and had the game decided early. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] will be looking for answers on defense.

stories.h: Virginia drops 59 on an FCS West opponent, winning 59-10
stories.d: [[t:832438405|Virginia]] rolled up 520 yards and looked like the better team from the opening drive. Staffers said they liked the tempo.

quote.text: That's what a statement looks like.

stories.h: G.Heeney leaves USF's secondary chasing shadows with three touchdowns
stories.d: [[p:557723324|G.Heeney]] caught seven passes and scored three times against [[t:832438399|USF]]. The USF cornerbacks are still looking for answers.

quote.text: He was open every time we blinked.

stories.h: M.Vitti scores three times as bracket coverage fails against an FCS East team
stories.d: [[p:557726535|M.Vitti]] caught seven passes and made every defensive adjustment look useless. Sources said opponents were already game-planning around him.

stories.h: Ole Miss holds the lead for Wilds, but Texas won't back off
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has the edge for five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with [[t:832438384|Texas]] right behind and Oklahoma still in the mix. Wilds wants a title contender, and sources say he is weighing who is likeliest to win one.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually winning it all?
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

stories.h: Missouri clings to a slim lead over Indiana for Favre
stories.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] is ahead for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], but Indiana has closed hard and Michigan is lurking. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and Missouri's staff has reportedly been working to make that case.

quote.text: Indiana has changed the way his family talks about this. It's a real race now.
quote.by: a person familiar with Favre's thinking

stories.h: Clemson leads for Coburn, but home-state pull could swing it to Alabama
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has the advantage for five-star [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]], but proximity to home is his dealbreaker and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] is a short drive from Coral Springs. Ole Miss is also lurking.

quote.text: His mom keeps saying she wants to see him play on Saturdays. That matters.
quote.by: a source close to the family

stories.h: Georgia leads Miami for Yeast, but playing time is the wild card
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] holds the edge for five-star receiver [[r:561121494|W. Yeast]]. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has been selling an immediate role and has not backed down, and Florida State is lurking. Georgia's staff is reportedly feeling it.

quote.text: He doesn't want to wait his turn. Whoever shows him the field wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Texas Tech edges Texas for Wolf in a tight playing-time fight
stories.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has a slim lead for five-star corner [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]], with Ole Miss lurking. Wolf cares about early snaps, and both staffs have pitched him a quick path to the field.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to who lets him start as a freshman.

stories.h: Notre Dame's national spotlight is working on Longo
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] leads for five-star receiver [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], with [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and Oklahoma close behind. Longo wants national exposure, and Notre Dame offers plenty of it. Official visits could decide this one.

quote.text: He loves the idea of playing on that stage every Saturday.

stories.h: Trueblood Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is an 89-overall guard earning nothing in NIL, while players like him command around 90K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has deep pockets, so fixing it should be easy, if it wants to.

stories.h: Neighbors may be a bad fit in Ohio State's offense
stories.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] is a 91-overall receiver on a team ranked 125th of 138 in receptions. After the Nebraska loss, a source says other programs are already sniffing around.

quote.text: He's a playmaker who isn't getting the ball. Guys like that start listening.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Lyle could hit the portal if Ohio State's passing game stays stuck
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]], a 90-overall pocket passer, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] offense ranked 130th of 138 in passing yards per game. The loss to Nebraska only fueled the chatter about his future.

quote.text: He wants to throw the ball. Right now that's not the offense.
quote.by: a person close to the QB room

stories.h: Blunt's future at Ohio State is murky as the run game sputters
stories.d: [[p:557717760|S.Blunt]], an 88-overall back, plays for an [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] team ranked 127th of 138 in rushing yards per game. A back who seeks contact wants carries, and the scheme isn't giving him many.

quote.text: He's built to run downhill. The offense isn't set up for it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Texas Receiver T.Bada Is Producing Like a Star and Earning Nothing
stories.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] is an 87-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while comparable receivers get around 90K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has one of the deepest collectives in the country, but rivals are already calling.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The only question is whether Texas fixes it before somebody else does.

stories.h: E.Udoh Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver with no NIL money, while receivers at his level get around 105K. Collectives know the gap well, and one source says he has already heard from several of them.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he knows the market. His phone isn't quiet.
quote.by: a person familiar with his situation

stories.h: Boger is underpaid, and Wake Forest may have to pay up
stories.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 84-overall quarterback making 65K, while players at his position and rating command around 160K. That gap tends to close in the portal. [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] needs to decide how much he's worth.

quote.text: Somebody's going to pay him. It's just a matter of who calls first.
